**Signal**: native `composer.googleapis.com/environment/healthy` (fraction true < 0.5 for 15 min). Native platform metric — deliberately not re-created under an Atlas name (ADR-011).

**Meaning**: the atlas-dev Composer environment is failing its own health checks.

**Runbook**: docs/observability-runbook-sprint5.md#alert-atlas-composer-unhealthy

**Owner**: the primary operator (primary operator).

**Test method**: not drill-injectable without harming the environment; validated by observing the metric during environment creation/deletion windows.

**Teardown**: DISABLE this policy before intentional Composer deletion (scripts/manage_atlas_alerts.sh disable atlas-composer-unhealthy); metric absence after deletion does not fire, but disabling removes ambiguity.
